title: The Tigers get on the board when Jim Adduci slashes a single, scoring Nick Caste
snippet: The Tigers get on the board when Jim Adduci slashes a single, scoring Nick Castellanos from first base as Eddie Rosario crumples in left field. Adduci is hitting .283. Rosario is out of the game.
